documents.title: Feed water operating envelope
documents.text: P-101A is the duty feed water pump. P-101B is the standby pump. The sample operating pressure is 8.2 bar and the design pressure is 16 bar. V-101 provides buffer capacity. E-101 heats the feed water before FV-101 controls flow to the process header. Verify against approved plant documents before taking operational action.

documents.title: Diagram review checklist
documents.text: Review every extracted tag against the equipment register. Check unconnected instruments, duplicate tags, dangling pipe endpoints, unmatched bill-of-materials entries, and incompatible line classes. Diagram review is not a hazard study or a safety certification.
